contexts.text: Jacob was wroth and chode with Laban () = the zeal of the Natural. Explained.
The people chode with Moses () = grievous complaining against Divine truth. AC 8566.
In the Original Language, Meribah means contention or chiding, and chiding = complaining.
On account of the chiding of the Sons of Israel () = complaining from the grievousness of the temptation until they were nearly yielding. Chiding = grievous complaining.
For fear of the scoldings of the wife.
